summary: Migrated outfits/calendar/wear-history from localStorage to PostgreSQL API. Implemented Ollama tool calling so AI chat can query the DB directly instead of receiving entire wardrobe in prompt. Added 10 DB query tools, tool execution loop, and refactored frontend chat to use async job queue + SSE.

item_sync.when: Awaited at start of DOMContentLoaded, before any rendering
item_sync.what: Fetches GET /api/items, normalizes image_url→image, saves to appData.items in localStorage

outfit_sync.what: Fetches GET /api/outfits, normalizes item_ids→itemIds and body_image_url→bodyBackground, saves to appData.outfits in localStorage

calendar_sync.what: Fetches GET /api/calendar, converts API array to date-keyed object, saves to appData.calendar in localStorage

migration.when: Called once before sync functions in DOMContentLoaded
migration.what: One-time migration of localStorage outfits/calendar to API. Checks gothreads_migrated_to_api flag.

data_flow.outfits: Now stored in PostgreSQL (outfits + outfit_items tables). Synced to localStorage for rendering.
data_flow.calendar: Now stored in PostgreSQL (calendar_events table). Synced to localStorage for rendering.
data_flow.wear_history: Stored in PostgreSQL (wear_history table). Logged via POST /api/wear.

outfits_new.GET /api/outfits/{id}: Get outfit with items and positions

wear_new.POST /api/wear: Log wear for outfit + all its items, increments wear_count

ai_jobs.POST /api/ai/jobs: Submit job by type, returns 202 + {id, status}

ai_job_queue.description: Generic async job queue. All AI ops go through POST/GET/DELETE /api/ai/jobs.
ai_job_queue.notification_panel: #ai-job-notifications, bottom-right, slide-in cards with cancel button

chat_job.description: New in session 10. Uses Ollama /api/chat with tool calling instead of /api/generate.

ai_tool_calling.description: AI chat can now query the DB directly via Ollama's native tool calling API (/api/chat with tools array). This replaces the old approach of stuffing the entire wardrobe into the prompt.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List wardrobe items with optional filters

tools.name: list_outfits
tools.description: List saved outfits with item names

tools.name: get_outfit
tools.description: Get outfit with items and positions

system_prompt_key_instructions: Always use tools to look up wardrobe data — don't guess
Reference items by actual names and IDs
When suggesting outfits, explain why items work together

main.go.callOllamaChatWithFallback: Tries primary model, falls back to secondary
main.go.getWardrobeTools: Returns 10 tool definitions with JSON Schema parameters
main.go.executeToolCall: Dispatcher: switch on tool name → call matching tool* DB function
main.go.runToolCallingLoop: Loop: call LLM → execute tool calls → feed results → repeat (max 10)
main.go.runChatJob: Worker: builds system prompt + history + user message, calls runToolCallingLoop

db.go.toolListItems: Dynamic WHERE with ILIKE filters, returns compact fields (no image_url/ai_analysis)
db.go.toolGetWardrobeStats: Three GROUP BY queries for category/color/season counts
db.go.toolSearchItems: ILIKE across name, brand, description, color

Refactored confirmDeleteOutfit() to async DELETE from API
Refactored duplicateOutfit() to async POST to API

Refactored saveCalendarOutfit() to async with API + location

Added runToolCallingLoop with max 10 iterations and status callbacks

app.js.syncCalendarFromAPI: Fetches /api/calendar, converts to date-keyed object, populates appData.calendar
app.js.migrateLocalStorageToAPI: One-time migration of localStorage outfits/calendar to API
app.js.submitAIJob: Generic: POST /api/ai/jobs, creates notification, opens EventSource, returns Promise
app.js.sendChatMessage: Submits 'chat' job with message + history, listens via SSE for status/result
app.js.logWearEvent: POST /api/wear, updates local wear counts for outfit and items
app.js.confirmSaveOutfit: Async: POST (create) or PUT (edit via _editingOutfitId) to /api/outfits
app.js.handleTryOn: Gets person_image from canvas bg, garment_image from targetItem, submits tryon job

main.go.runChatJob: Builds system prompt + history, calls runToolCallingLoop, returns AI's final text
main.go.runToolCallingLoop: Call LLM → execute tool calls → feed results → repeat (max 10 iterations)
main.go.executeToolCall: Switch on tool name, parse JSON args, call matching tool* DB function
main.go.callOllamaChat: POSTs to Ollama /api/chat with messages + tools
main.go.getWardrobeTools: Returns 10 tool definitions with JSON Schema parameters

db.go.handleCreateOutfit: POST /api/outfits — inserts outfit + outfit_items with positions
db.go.handleLogWear: POST /api/wear — logs for all items in outfit, increments wear_count
db.go.toolListItems: Internal: dynamic WHERE with ILIKE filters for AI tool calling
db.go.toolGetWardrobeStats: Internal: aggregated category/color/season counts for AI
